entities.name: Croag
entities.description: A Phyrexian member of Yawgmoth's Inner Circle and lord over the Evincar of Rath, overseer of Rath.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Phyrexian whose Inner Circle Croag belonged to.

entities.name: Davvol
entities.description: Evincar of Rath who schemed against Croag and was trapped by him.

entities.name: Gatha
entities.description: Person Croag sought regarding the Bloodline Project.

entities.name: Bloodline Project
entities.description: Project whose progress Croag wanted to uncover.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Figure Croag was tasked to find and kill.

events.summary: Croag and Davvol bring Dominarian populations to Rath.
Croag is seriously wounded in battle by Kreig of Keld while seeking Gatha.
events.quote: he was seriously wounded by Kreig of Keld in a battle

events.summary: Having recovered, Croag defeats Davvol's negator and traps Davvol in the Death Pits of Rath.
events.quote: he defeated Davvol's negator and trapped Davvol

relations.quote: a Phyrexian member of Yawgmoth 's Inner Circle

relations.note: Davvol schemed against him and Croag trapped him.
relations.quote: Davvol devised ways to get rid of him

relations.note: Tasked to find and kill Urza.
relations.quote: General Croag's task was also to find and kill Urza
